pnp:WebSettings.Title: IT Governance, Risk & Compliance
pnp:WebSettings.Description: The governance, risk and compliance hub for LHG's IT function. Managed by the GM Information Technology.

pnp:SiteGroup.Title: IT-GRC-IT
pnp:SiteGroup.Description: IT team members — full Edit access to the IT GRC site

pnp:SiteGroup.Title: IT-GRC-Risk
pnp:SiteGroup.Description: Risk and compliance team — Contribute access to risk and policy sections

pnp:SiteGroup.Title: IT-GRC-PMO
pnp:SiteGroup.Description: Project Management Office — Contribute access to project and programme sections

pnp:SiteGroup.Title: IT-GRC-Exec
pnp:SiteGroup.Description: Executive audience (COO, Board, Risk Committee) — Read-only access

pnp:ListInstance.Title: IT Risk Register
pnp:ListInstance.Description: Source of truth for all IT risk items. Full granularity — operational, tactical, technical. Escalation threshold metadata drives integration with the enterprise risk register.

pnp:ListInstance.Title: CMDB — Asset & Configuration Register
pnp:ListInstance.Description: Structured register of IT assets, configuration attributes, care impact classification, and lifecycle status.

pnp:ListInstance.Title: Policy, Standards & Principles Library
pnp:ListInstance.Description: Controlled library of IT policies, architecture principles, and standards with named owners, version control, and review cycles.

pnp:ListInstance.Title: Projects & Programme
pnp:ListInstance.Description: Active IT projects, RAG status, budget tracking, and FY roadmap. Primary audience: PMO, IT team, Exec.

pnp:ListInstance.Title: Essential Eight Maturity
pnp:ListInstance.Description: ACSC Essential Eight maturity assessment register. Tracks current vs target maturity by control, gap analysis, and remediation actions.

Field.Name: MaturityGap
Field.Formula: =IF(ISNUMBER(VALUE(RIGHT([Target Maturity Level],1))),VALUE(RIGHT([Target Maturity Level],1))-VALUE(RIGHT([Current Maturity Level],1)),0)

pnp:ListInstance.Title: Change Log
pnp:ListInstance.Description: Record of all IT changes reviewed and approved by the Change Advisory Board (CAB). Includes care impact classification and outcome tracking.

pnp:ListInstance.Title: Incident Register
pnp:ListInstance.Description: IT incident register. Tracks all incidents by severity, care impact classification, notifiability under the Aged Care Act 2024, and resolution status.

pnp:ListInstance.Title: Training & Awareness Register
pnp:ListInstance.Description: Register of IT training and awareness modules including SCORM, phishing simulations, and policy acknowledgements. Tracks assignment, completion, and currency.

Welcome to the IT GRC site

This site is the governance, risk and compliance hub for LHG's IT function. Use the left navigation to access each section. This site is managed by the GM Information Technology.

Sections: Executive Dashboard | Risk & Compliance | Policy, Standards & Principles | Projects & Programme | Cyber & Security | IT Operations & Architecture | Training & Awareness | Essential Eight Maturity
Cyber risk posture, programme status, and the IT risk register at a glance. Audience: COO, Risk Committee, Board.
IT Risk Register — High & Critical Risks
IT risk register, incident register, and escalation to the enterprise risk register. Audience: Risk Committee, IT team.
Controlled IT policies, architecture principles, and standards with named owners, version control, and review cycles. Audience: IT team, Risk, All staff.
FY2026/27 delivery, RAG status, budget and the change pipeline. Audience: PMO, IT team, Exec.
Essential Eight maturity, vulnerability tracking, and incident posture. Audience: IT team, Risk, COO.
CMDB, care impact classification, architecture documentation, and the change log. Audience: IT team, MSP (limited).
SCORM modules, phishing resilience, and AI policy communications. Audience: All staff, IT team.

This assessment uses the ACSC Essential Eight Maturity Model (0–3). Level 0 = not performed. Level 1 = partly aligned. Level 2 = mostly aligned. Level 3 = fully aligned. Target: Level 2 across all controls by end of FY2026/27.
